mapper.select: select p.*, pr.product_name, m.manufacturer_name, pr.stock as current_stock from purchase p left join product pr on p.product_id = pr.product_id left join manufacturer m on p.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id order by p.purchase_id desc

select p.*, pr.product_name, m.manufacturer_name, pr.stock as current_stock from purchase p left join product pr on p.product_id = pr.product_id left join manufacturer m on p.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id where p.purchase_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into purchase (product_id, manufacturer_id, purchase_quantity, purchase_date, status, notes) values (#{productId}, #{manufacturerId}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{purchaseDate}, #{status}, #{notes})
